page.title: Free printable story worksheets
page.meta_description: Eight free printable story worksheets for K-5 classrooms — story maps, character profiles, storyboards, book reports and more. No sign-in needed.
page.intro: Eight ready-to-print pages for story writing, free and with no sign-in. Print one for the whole class as-is, or customize it first.

story_map.title: Story map
story_map.description: Beginning, middle and end, each with room to draw and write.

character_profile.title: Character profile
character_profile.description: Draw a character, then describe how they look, what they like, want and fear.

setting_sketch.title: Setting sketch
setting_sketch.description: Draw the place a story happens, then describe what you'd see, hear and smell there.

storyboard.title: Storyboard
storyboard.description: Six panels to sketch out a story in order, with two lines under each one.

sentence_starters.title: Sentence starters
sentence_starters.description: A strip of starter phrases to finish in your own words.

book_report.title: Book report
book_report.description: Title, author, favorite part and character, a star rating, and a scene to draw.

feelings_checkin.title: Feelings check-in card
feelings_checkin.description: Circle how you feel and what would help — no scores, just faces and words.

about_author.title: About the author
about_author.description: A page about the person who wrote the book: you.

sheet.footer: Make it a real book at mybooklab.app

setting_sketch.question: What can you see / hear / smell?

sentence_starters.finish_prompt: Finish each sentence in your own words.

book_report.draw_scene: Draw a scene from the book

feelings_checkin.why_prompt: Why do I feel this way?

about_author.my_next_book: My next book will be about…

customize.heading: Customize
customize.title_hint: Changes the sheet's own prompt line — for example, the story map's writing cue.
customize.prefill_hint: Paste a class list, one name per line (or comma-separated), and print one copy per name with the name already filled in.
